findings_to_judge.finding: Petco's Q2 and FY2026 guidance explicitly assumes NO further IEEPA tariff refunds beyond the partial one received in May 2026, yet CBP's CAPE Phase 2 opened 29 June 2026 and BARK - a pet-products importer - booked a reconciliation line item literally labelled 'IEEPA Tariffs Phase II' worth $7.363M in the quarter ended 30 June 2026, which sits entirely inside Petco's 3 May - 1 Aug fiscal Q2.

Petco's FY2026 guide is pinned to 'fuel prices remain elevated at approximately those experienced in the first quarter' - fiscal Q1 (Feb-Apr) averaged about $4.71/gal diesel on BTS monthlies ($3.72 / $4.92 / $5.50), fiscal Q2 (May-Jul) averaged about $5.20, and diesel was $5.599/gal on 31 Aug with US diesel cracks setting an all-time record above $106/bbl on 1 Sep and record-low seasonal distillate stocks going into heating season - leaving the stated H2 assumption roughly 19% below spot.

The two freshest independent pet-category datapoints both landed on 5 August 2026, after Petco last spoke, and both improved with raised guidance - Central Garden & Pet's Pet segment organic net sales +2% for the quarter ended 27 June 2026 with FY non-GAAP EPS raised to '$2.85 or better' from '$2.70 or better', and Freshpet net sales +15.5% to $305.6M with FY net sales growth raised to 10-12% - while Chewy, the market's default category anchor, does not report until 9 September, a week AFTER Petco.

19.51M shares are short against a float of only 90.59M - 21.5% of float and 13.46 days to cover on 1.46M average daily volume - and with the option chain unusable (ATM spread 120% of mid) shorts can only cover in the stock, into a name whose last seven prints moved +34.6%, +31.6%, +23.5%, +14.5%, +8.0%, -6.1% and -23.3%.
